ingress_rule_type.title: Ingress Rule Specification Type
ingress_rule_type.description: Indicates whether ingress rules are defined using strict IP allowlists, broad CIDR ranges, or cloud-native service tags that may include untrusted sources. Also captures whether any rule permits internet-sourced traffic (0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0).

permits_internet_sourced_traffic.title: Permits Internet-Sourced Ingress Traffic
permits_internet_sourced_traffic.description: Whether any ingress rule allows traffic originating from the public internet (0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0) to reach cloud-hosted services in the zone.

allowlisted_source_count.title: Number of Explicitly Allowlisted Source Networks
allowlisted_source_count.description: Count of explicitly defined, specific source IP ranges or prefixes permitted in ingress rules, excluding any wildcard or service tag entries.

egress_allowlist_enforcement.title: Egress Allowlist Enforcement Level
egress_allowlist_enforcement.description: The level at which outbound traffic destinations are explicitly permitted. 'full' means all egress is restricted to an approved FQDN/IP allowlist with deny-all default. 'partial' means some rules exist but not all workloads are covered. 'none' means no destination-based egress allowlist is enforced.

deep_packet_inspection_enabled.title: Deep Packet Inspection Enabled
deep_packet_inspection_enabled.description: Whether egress traffic passes through a DPI-capable firewall or NGFW that inspects payload content for C2 patterns, data exfiltration, and protocol anomalies before leaving the trust zone.

dns_layer_filtering_enabled.title: DNS-Layer Filtering Enabled
dns_layer_filtering_enabled.description: Whether outbound DNS queries from workloads are inspected and filtered via a DNS security gateway capable of blocking C2 domains and detecting DNS tunneling.

workload_types_in_shared_segment.title: Workload Types in Shared Network Segment
workload_types_in_shared_segment.description: List of workload trust classifications present in the same VPC/subnet (e.g., 'internal', 'external', 'dmz'). When both internal and external classifications coexist without micro-segmentation, a trust boundary collapse is indicated.

subnet_security_group_enforcement.title: Subnet-Level Security Group Enforcement Enabled
subnet_security_group_enforcement.description: Indicates whether distinct security groups or network ACLs are applied at the subnet level to enforce inter-zone traffic restrictions between internal and external workload subnets.

inter_zone_routing_policy.title: Inter-Zone Routing Policy
inter_zone_routing_policy.description: Describes the routing policy applied between trust zones within the shared network segment. 'none' means no routing restrictions exist, 'permissive' means routes exist with minimal filtering, 'restrictive' means explicit allow-list routes with inspection, 'micro_segmented' means workload-level isolation enforced.

distinct_subnets_per_trust_tier.title: Distinct Subnets Provisioned Per Trust Tier
distinct_subnets_per_trust_tier.description: Indicates whether separate subnets are provisioned for each trust tier (internal vs external workloads). True means each trust tier has its own dedicated subnet(s); false means workloads of different trust tiers share the same subnet(s).

mutual_tls_enforced.title: Mutual TLS Enforced for East-West Traffic
mutual_tls_enforced.description: Whether mutual TLS (mTLS) is enforced for all inter-service communication within the service mesh, requiring both client and server to present and validate certificates at each hop.

per_hop_authorization_policy.title: Per-Hop Authorization Policy Configured
per_hop_authorization_policy.description: Whether explicit authorization policies exist that require re-verification of service identity at each zone boundary crossing, rather than relying on transitive network adjacency trust.

service_identity_validation_mode.title: Service Identity Validation Mode
service_identity_validation_mode.description: The mode used to validate service identities in east-west traffic — whether identity is cryptographically verified per request, validated via network identity (IP/namespace), or not validated.

federation_role_mapping_scope.title: Federation Role Mapping Scope
federation_role_mapping_scope.description: Indicates whether external identity provider role mappings are broad (wildcard/any-group) or restricted to specific groups/claims.

audience_restriction_enforced.title: Audience Restriction Enforced
audience_restriction_enforced.description: Whether the federation trust policy enforces a specific audience (aud) claim on tokens issued by the external identity provider, preventing token reuse across services.

assumed_role_privilege_level.title: Assumed Role Privilege Level
assumed_role_privilege_level.description: The privilege level of the IAM role(s) that external federated identities can assume.

peering_route_filter_enforced.title: Peering Route Filter Enforced
peering_route_filter_enforced.description: Whether route-level access controls (prefix filters, route tables, or NACLs) are explicitly configured to restrict traffic over VPC peering connections, private endpoints, or cloud interconnects to only intended destinations.

third_party_networks_in_peering.title: Third-Party or Partner Networks Present in Peering
third_party_networks_in_peering.description: Whether any peered network belongs to a third-party, partner, or external organization rather than being fully owned and controlled by the same trust zone owner.

private_endpoint_network_policy_enabled.title: Private Endpoint Network Policy Enabled
private_endpoint_network_policy_enabled.description: Whether network policies are enabled and applied to private endpoint subnets to restrict which sources can reach the private endpoint.

management_plane_network_isolated.title: Management Plane Network Isolation Enforced
management_plane_network_isolated.description: Indicates whether management/control plane interfaces are on a dedicated, separate network segment not reachable from data-plane workload segments.

management_api_access_control_scope.title: Management API Access Control Scope
management_api_access_control_scope.description: Describes the network-level access control applied to management and administration interfaces — whether access is restricted to a dedicated management network, specific IP ranges, or open to any workload segment.

data_plane_to_control_plane_routes_exist.title: Routable Paths from Data-Plane to Control Plane Exist
data_plane_to_control_plane_routes_exist.description: Indicates whether network routes exist that allow data-plane workload segments to directly reach management/control plane endpoints without traversing an explicit security boundary.

management_access_requires_dedicated_bas.title: Management Access Requires Dedicated Bastion or VPN
management_access_requires_dedicated_bas.description: Indicates whether all administrative access to management plane interfaces is mandated to go through a dedicated bastion host or management VPN separate from data-plane traffic paths.

inter_zone_flow_logging_enabled.title: Inter-Zone Flow Logging Enabled
inter_zone_flow_logging_enabled.description: Whether network flow logs are enabled and capturing traffic crossing the boundary between internal and external user data segments.

inter_zone_anomaly_detection_enabled.title: Inter-Zone Anomaly Detection Enabled
inter_zone_anomaly_detection_enabled.description: Whether automated anomaly detection or alerting rules are configured specifically for traffic crossing the boundary between internal and external user data zones.

principal_scope.title: Bucket Policy Principal Scope
principal_scope.description: The broadest principal specifier present in the bucket's IAM/resource policy, indicating how widely access is granted.

cross_zone_workload_access_permitted.title: Cross-Zone Workload Access Permitted by Policy
cross_zone_workload_access_permitted.description: Whether the bucket policy explicitly permits or fails to restrict access from workloads in adjacent or external trust zones.

network_boundary_control_enforced.title: Network Boundary Control Enforced
network_boundary_control_enforced.description: Whether a cloud-native network boundary control (VPC Service Controls perimeter, Private Endpoint policy, or equivalent) wraps the storage bucket to prevent access from outside the defined trust zone regardless of IAM policy.

distinct_trust_tiers_sharing_nat_gateway.title: Distinct Trust Tiers Sharing NAT Gateway
distinct_trust_tiers_sharing_nat_gateway.description: Indicates whether workloads classified at different trust levels share a single NAT gateway or common internet egress point, eliminating network-observable separation at egress.

egress_traffic_attribution_mechanism.title: Egress Traffic Attribution Mechanism
egress_traffic_attribution_mechanism.description: The method used to distinguish and attribute egress traffic by originating trust zone — from no mechanism, to flow-log tagging only, to dedicated per-zone egress paths.

zone_egress_firewall_policy_enforced.title: Zone-Specific Egress Firewall Policy Enforced
zone_egress_firewall_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether distinct egress firewall or security group policies are applied per trust zone to restrict and differentiate outbound traffic flows before they reach the shared egress point.
